newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end ahead in thin pre-Easter trade.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end ahead in thin pre-Easter trade.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed ahead for the second straight day in slow pre-Easter trade with leading utility Electricidad de Caracas accounting for nearly half of the session's scant trade.
The bolsa's 19-share index gained 0.48 percent to end at 6,344.49 points as 6.7 million shares traded worth three billion bolivars ($6.3 million).
"Next week could see continuing slight rises, although it depends on continuing progress with social security reform," said Intervalores broker Ricardo Marino.
Last week, Venezuela signed an historic agreement to reform its crumbling social security system, but the complex bill, plus supporting legal reforms, still has to pass congress.
Among traded issues, 14 rose, eight fell and 12 closed flat. Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, closed ahead 0.55 percent at 97.58.
Nearly three million shares in Electricidad de Caracas exchanged hands, the stock closing up 7.75 bolivars at 525.00.
Markets are closed Thursday and Friday for Easter holidays.
